title: Strip tmux from entrypoint.sh
description: Remove the tmux session creation, attach, and probe logic from scripts/entrypoint.sh. The entrypoint should launch the shell directly (exec zsh or similar) instead of wrapping in a tmux session. Keep the CLAUDE_DEV_NO_TMUX env var removal too. Ensure tini still handles signal propagation correctly without tmux.

title: Remove tmux from Dockerfile
description: Remove tmux from the apt-get install line in the Dockerfile. Remove any COPY lines that copy tmux.conf into the image. Remove tmux from the /etc/claude-dev/configs/ staging if applicable.

title: Rewrite tests to not depend on tmux
description: In tests/smoke.bats, remove tmux binary and config checks. In tests/experience.bats and tests/helpers/setup.bash, rewrite the interactive tests to use a different approach (e.g., script/expect, or direct command execution) instead of tmux send-keys/capture-pane. This is the hardest subtask — the experience test harness is built on tmux.

title: Remove teammateMode tmux from Claude settings
description: In config/claude-settings.json, remove teammateMode: tmux. Keep CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS if agent teams can work without tmux, otherwise remove that too. Note: agent teams may need an alternative teammate mode or may simply not be supported without tmux — document this decision.

title: Ensure clean container shutdown without tmux
description: With tmux removed, verify that docker stop still cleanly terminates all processes. The current chain is: SIGTERM → tini → tmux → shells. Without tmux it becomes: SIGTERM → tini → shell (via exec). Verify tini + exec properly propagates signals. Test with docker stop and confirm no zombie processes.

title: Delete tmux.conf and agent-panels.sh
description: Delete config/tmux.conf, .claude-dev/config/tmux.conf, and scripts/agent-panels.sh. Remove the tmux.local.conf documentation from CLAUDE.md config customization table.

title: Delete claude-screen wrapper and revert aliases
description: Delete scripts/claude-screen entirely. In config/.zshrc, change all aliases (cs, csd, cn) and the claude() function to call 'claude' directly instead of 'claude-screen'. Remove the ap alias for agent-panels too.

title: Remove tmux from container template (epic)
description: tmux has been causing persistent scroll issues that multiple fix attempts haven't resolved. Remove tmux entirely from the container template. This is the parent epic tracking all subtasks.
close_reason: Epic tracker — closing to unblock subtasks

title: Test tmux scroll fix end-to-end
description: Manual verification checklist: (1) Launch Claude via cs/cn alias, (2) scroll up with mouse wheel - should NOT show shell history, (3) exit Claude, (4) scroll up - should show shell history normally, (5) Test ctrl-c exit from Claude - screen should restore properly, (6) Test in agent team pane if applicable. Also verify that the wrapper doesn't break Claude Code's own UI rendering.
close_reason: All tests pass: alternate_on=1 during wrapper, alternate_on=0 after ctrl-c cleanup, wrapper bypasses outside tmux, smoke tests 1-15 pass, all changed files consistent

title: Update shell aliases to use claude-screen wrapper
description: Modify /workspace/config/.zshrc to wrap the Claude Code aliases (cs, csd, cn) with the claude-screen wrapper. Change: alias cs='claude-screen --dangerously-skip-permissions', alias csd='claude-screen --dangerously-skip-permissions --debug', alias cn='claude-screen'. The plain 'claude' command should also be wrapped, possibly via a shell function that checks if running inside tmux before wrapping.
close_reason: Updated cs/csd/cn aliases to use claude-screen wrapper

title: Create claude-screen wrapper script
description: Create /usr/local/bin/claude-screen that wraps Claude Code with alternate screen sequences (smcup/rmcup). The wrapper should: (1) send smcup (printf '\e[?1049h') to enter alternate screen, (2) clear the alternate screen, (3) run claude with all passed arguments, (4) trap EXIT/INT/TERM to always send rmcup (printf '\e[?1049l') on exit. This makes tmux's #{alternate_on} flag true while Claude is running, so the existing WheelUpPane binding correctly eats scroll events instead of entering copy-mode.
close_reason: Created /workspace/scripts/claude-screen wrapper, added to Dockerfile and PATH

title: Wire up Wozcode plugin auto-install
description: scripts/install-wozcode.sh exists (idempotent installer that runs claude plugin marketplace add WithWoz/wozcode-plugin + claude plugin install woz@wozcode-marketplace once Claude is authenticated). Still needs: (1) Dockerfile COPY into /usr/local/bin/install-wozcode with chmod +x, (2) entrypoint.sh invocation after the auth-related setup so it runs on each container start until prerequisites are met, (3) commit + push, (4) verify by --rebuild on a downstream project that the install actually succeeds (real-world verification per template rules). Opt-out via CLAUDE_DEV_NO_WOZCODE=1 already supported.

title: Update launcher to detect and pass HOST_HOME
description: Detect host HOME in launcher.sh, guard against /home/agent conflict, add HOST_HOME to sed substitution in bootstrap_repo() and regenerate_compose()

title: Add host home mount to docker-compose template
description: Add HOST_HOME volume mount (read-only) to docker-compose.yml.template so dragged file paths from the host resolve inside the container

title: Remove tmux config sync from entrypoint
description: Remove the checksum-based config sync logic for tmux.conf from entrypoint.sh (the block that copies workspace config to the volume). Also remove .tmux.local.conf handling.

title: Update shell config to remove tmux detection
description: In config/.zshrc, remove the TMUX env var detection/export block (the if block that sets TMUX and TMUX_PANE). This block is only needed for docker exec into tmux sessions.

title: Remove tmux references from CLAUDE.md and README
description: Remove the Agent Teams section from CLAUDE.md (it depends on tmux). Remove tmux from the Environment tools list. Remove the .tmux.local.conf row from the Config Customization table. Remove tmux-related aliases from Quick Reference. Update README.md to remove agent teams / tmux references.

title: Handle agent team spawning with alternate screen
description: When Claude Code spawns agent teammates in tmux panes (teammateMode: tmux), each teammate pane also needs alternate screen protection. Investigate how agent-panels.sh and Claude Code's teammate spawning works, and ensure the wrapper is applied to spawned agents too. Check if Claude Code uses a specific command to launch teammates - if so, the wrapper needs to intercept that path as well.
close_reason: Non-issue: teammate panes are created fresh by tmux split-window, so they have no prior shell history to leak into copy-mode. Only the primary pane (where user launched claude from shell) is affected, and that's covered by the claude-screen wrapper + aliases.

title: Document drag-and-drop file access in CLAUDE.md
description: Add documentation section explaining drag-and-drop works automatically for files under host HOME, and to use attachments/ for files outside HOME

title: Update tmux config comments to document actual behavior
description: Update the WheelUpPane binding comment in /workspace/config/tmux.conf (lines 30-33) to accurately describe the situation: Claude Code does NOT use alternate screen natively - the claude-screen wrapper forces it. Also update the commit history context so future developers understand the full chain of reasoning.
close_reason: Updated WheelUpPane comment to document that Claude Code needs the claude-screen wrapper for alternate screen
